hook: Your bathtub water could float the planet Saturn.
title: Saturn Is Light Enough to Float
description:
Saturn is less dense than water, because it's mostly hydrogen and helium. So in a giant enough ocean, the whole planet would float. Of course, no such ocean exists.

#Shorts #Saturn #Space
